title: Tool Use & Function Calling — Separate Read Actions from Write Actions
key_insight: Give each tool the least authority needed. Require confirmation and idempotency keys for important writes, and log who requested and approved them.
body:
## Separate Read Actions from Write Actions

Looking up inventory is reversible; issuing a refund changes the world. Treating both tools alike creates risk.

Give each tool the least authority needed. Require confirmation and idempotency keys for important writes, and log who requested and approved them.

Limit loops, time, cost, and result size. A tool agent needs a bounded failure policy rather than retrying forever.
common_mistakes: A model response automatically has every system credential.
Retries are safe even when they repeat payments.
mini_exercise: Draw “Separate Read Actions from Write Actions” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Models need tools to query live systems, calculate reliably, and take controlled actions beyond text generation.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Separate Read Actions from Write Actions,” explain Tool Use & Function Calling without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
